config._about: Quant Lab — paper-trading research system. INR base. EDUCATIONAL RESEARCH ONLY, not investment advice. Edit values here; everything reads from this file.
config._books_note: Core-satellite 70/30 of a single ₹1,00,000: ₹70k in the balanced core + ₹30k in the aggressive satellite. Follow both books' daily calls together. Change the split, or drop to one book, anytime.
config._defensive_note: Diversifier basket held alongside momentum stocks. Low-correlation-to-equity assets: gold + silver (metals), an InvIT (infra income), and a liquid/cash ETF. When allocation.mode='adaptive' these weights are RELATIVE (normalised to the defensive share); when 'fixed' they are absolute.
config._fill_note: Live paper: next-session open, cash-only delivery with settlement calendar. Legacy historical engine: same-day close, pending Phase4 alignment.
config._sleeves_note: Learned from backtests: fast mean-reversion (short_term) loses after Groww fees, so it starts at 0% and momentum gets the weight. 'equal_weight' keeps money invested to reduce cash drag vs buy&hold.
config._universe_file_note: When set, load_config replaces the inline universe below with the Nifty 500 list. Remove this key to fall back to the small curated list.

allocation._gate_note: Only hold a diversifier while IT is trending up (above its own 200-DMA); otherwise that slice sits in cash. So gold is held when gold is rising and stepped aside in its dead years — directly addressing 'gold only helps because it rallied'.
allocation._mode_note: 'fixed' = always the defensive_basket weights. 'adaptive' = tilt between equity and defensive by market regime: more equity when the market is strong, more defensive when weak. Changes the ratio over time by indicators (no look-ahead — uses only the trailing 50/200-DMA state).

costs._note: Groww equity charges, approximate as of 2026 — VERIFY against Groww's live brokerage calculator and update. All rates are fractions of turnover unless in INR.

entry_filters._edge_note: Skip an entry unless its expected move (target/stop distance) is at least this multiple of the estimated round-trip Groww cost %. Kills marginal trades the fees would eat.
entry_filters._hold_note: No signal/rank exit before this many bars (stops & targets still fire) — stops churn.
entry_filters._note: Cost-efficiency gates — the #1 lever found in backtests (over-trading a small book is fatal).

exits._note: Chandelier trailing stop: once in a trade the stop ratchets up to high_since_entry - trail_atr_mult*ATR (never down). 0 = off (mean-reversion exits on its own signal).

paper._adapt_note: Unused legacy setting; no trained ML or adaptive live weighting is claimed.
paper._inception_note: On first run the paper book starts this many trading days before the latest bar, so there is immediate forward-simulated history to review. Set to 0 to start clean from today. Reset with scripts/reset.py.

rebalance._long_term_rerank_note: Long-term sleeve re-ranks momentum every N trading days; drops names that fall out of the top set, rotates into new leaders.
rebalance._sleeve_reset_note: Every N trading days, log sleeve drift vs target allocation (cash is not force-moved between sleeves, only reported).

regime._note: Below the N-day MA: no NEW long entries (open positions still managed). size_scaling scales per-trade risk by regime strength (close vs 50/200 DMA), floored at factor_floor — smaller size in weak markets, full size in strong ones.

risk._note: Hard floor: if total value falls > circuit_breaker_dd from its peak, go fully defensive (liquidate stocks, hold basket + cash) regardless of signals, until NAV recovers within reset_dd, or after 63 completed sessions with the market trend on. A reset reanchors the risk peak and triggers a review; no parameter fitting.

selection._ext_note: Skip names more than this fraction above their 200-day line (0 = off). Anti-froth guard.
selection._note: Screens applied before momentum ranking — realism + risk control.
selection._sector_note: At most this many holdings from one sector — forces diversification.
selection._turnover_note: Only trade names with >= this median daily traded value (INR). ~5 crore/day keeps fills realistic and doubles as a point-in-time size filter (a stock enters only once it is actually liquid, reducing survivorship/look-ahead).

settlement._note: Live book realism: decide after close, order fills at the NEXT session's OPEN, delivery settles T+1 (~1-2 trading days to land in demat). Every fill (stocks AND ETFs like GOLDBEES) pays full Groww charges. The backtest engine still fills at close (a documented approximation); this only governs the live book.

tax._aware_note: Tax-aware exits: defer selling a WINNING equity held within ltcg_buffer_days of the 1-year mark, so 20% STCG becomes 12.5% LTCG (unless the circuit-breaker fires).
tax._note: Shared taxpayer FIFO and annual exemption, configured rates/slab, cess and surcharge. Instrument taxonomy is independent of allocation. Initial adjusted-price research units/distribution income remain limitations; see docs/ACCOUNTING_REPAIRS.md.
